product_metadata.title: Ottomanson Vinyl Tablecloth Polka Dot Design Indoor & Outdoor Non-Woven Backing Tablecloth, 55" X 70", Light Blue
features: A must have tablecloth in every house to protect your tables from wear, tear, damage, stain and spills. | Transform your eating experience with an instant and effortless addition of style and flair with this adorning tablecloth.

This all-purpose tablecloth will come in handy with reusable, easy to fold and store, wrinkle resistant, spill&waterproof performance as well as fuss-free maintenance with the minumum effort of just a simple wipe. | Made of robust heavy-weight yet smooth vinyl front and non-woven soft flannel backing.

With large scope of application indoor and outdoor, or for commercial use in restaurants, cefeterias and caterings, this practical and utilitarian tablecloths are budget and family-friendly. | This table cover takes on the dual job of being visually appealing and combatting stains and damages.
CARE INSTRUCTIONS: Super easy to clean - Just wipe using mild soap with damp cloth or sponge on the vinyl surface of this tablecloth for best results. Laundering and ironing is not recommended.
description: Introduce a whimsical note on your kitchen table, dinner space, patio, porch and picnic tables with our charming polka dot design tablecloth with decorative white polka dot motif on the soft and sweet baby-blue base to create a stylish contemporary foundation for every meal as well as visual appeal. Available in a rich assortment of sizes and shapes for an ideal fit to your space, this multi-purpose tablecloth is great for Thanksgiving Gatherings, Christmas Holiday, New Years Dining, Parties, Babyshowers, Picnics, Happy hours, Potlucks, Barbecues, Camping, Trips, Restaurants, Cafeterias and Caterings. Suitable for everyday usage as well as indoor and outdoor dining activities, this practical yet attractive piece will add extra joy and touch of delight to the taste of your meals and fun times. With large scope of application, these lovely and budget-friendly tablecloths also make great gifts for birthdays, holidays and new homebuyer visits. Durable and super easy to clean with minimal effort, this cozy tablecloth preserves your table from damages and stain while offering a carefree maintenance feasibility. Just wipe clean using mild soap with damp cloth or sponge on vinyl surface of this tablecloth for best results, which will help it remain attractive and serviceable for a long time. Laundering and ironing is not recommended. This premium-quality robust and reusable tablecloth covers worn and dated tables with spill and waterproof performance and keeps your tabletops free of spills and stains. As a protective layer, slippery and smooth vinyl surface promotes a breeze-like cleaning and a crisp look. All these exclusive features and designs will make this tablecloth the envy of your friends!
